legend: Codeforces is a wonderful platform and one its feature shows how much someone contributes to the community. Every registered user has contribution — an integer number, not necessarily positive. There are n registered users and the i-th of them has contribution ti.

Limak is a little polar bear and he's new into competitive programming. He doesn't even have an account in Codeforces but he is able to upvote existing blogs and comments. We assume that every registered user has infinitely many blogs and comments.
Limak can spend b minutes to read one blog and upvote it. Author's contribution will be increased by 5.
Limak can spend c minutes to read one comment and upvote it. Author's contribution will be increased by 1.
Note that it's possible that Limak reads blogs faster than comments.

Limak likes ties. He thinks it would be awesome to see a tie between at least k registered users. To make it happen he is going to spend some time on reading and upvoting. After that, there should exist an integer value x that at least k registered users have contribution exactly x.
How much time does Limak need to achieve his goal?
input: The first line contains four integers n, k, b and c (2 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 200 000, 1 ≤ b, c ≤ 1000) — the number of registered users, the required minimum number of users with the same contribution, time needed to read and upvote a blog, and time needed to read and upvote a comment, respectively.
The second line contains n integers t1, t2, ..., tn (|ti| ≤ 109) where ti denotes contribution of the i-th registered user.
output: Print the minimum number of minutes Limak will spend to get a tie between at least k registered users.
note: In the first sample, there are 4 registered users and Limak wants a tie between at least 3 of them. Limak should behave as follows.
He spends 100 minutes to read one blog of the 4-th user and increase his contribution from 1 to 6.
Then he spends 4·30 = 120 minutes to read four comments of the 2-nd user and increase his contribution from 2 to 6 (four times it was increaded by 1).
In the given scenario, Limak spends 100 + 4·30 = 220 minutes and after that each of users 2, 3, 4 has contribution 6.
In the second sample, Limak needs 30 minutes to read a blog and 100 minutes to read a comment. This time he can get 3 users with contribution equal to 12 by spending 100 + 3·30 = 190 minutes:
Spend 2·30 = 60 minutes to read two blogs of the 1-st user to increase his contribution from 2 to 12.
Spend 30 + 100 minutes to read one blog and one comment of the 3-rd user. His contribution will change from 6 to 6 + 5 + 1 = 12.

legend.ai: Codeforces 是一个很棒的平台，其中一项功能可以体现某人对社区的贡献程度。每位注册用户都有一个贡献值——它是一个整数，不一定为正。有 n 位注册用户，其中第 i 位用户的贡献值为 t_i。
Limak 是一只小北极熊，刚开始接触竞赛编程。他甚至还没有 Codeforces 账号，但可以给已有的博客和评论点赞。我们假设每位注册用户都有无限多篇博客和评论。
Limak 可以花费 b 分钟阅读并点赞一篇博客。作者的贡献值将增加 5。
Limak 可以花费 c 分钟阅读并点赞一条评论。作者的贡献值将增加 1。
注意，Limak 阅读博客的速度可能比阅读评论更快。
Limak 喜欢并列。他认为如果能看到至少 k 位注册用户之间出现并列，那将非常棒。为了实现这一点，他将花费一些时间进行阅读和点赞。完成后，应当存在一个整数值 x，使得至少 k 位注册用户的贡献值恰好为 x。
Limak 达成目标需要多长时间？

input.ai: 第一行包含四个整数 n、k、b 和 c（2 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 200000，1 ≤ b、c ≤ 1000）——分别表示注册用户数、具有相同贡献值的用户所需的最少人数、阅读并点赞一篇博客所需的时间，以及阅读并点赞一条评论所需的时间。
第二行包含 n 个整数 t1、t2、…、tn（|ti| ≤ 10^9），其中 ti 表示第 i 个注册用户的贡献值。

output.ai: 输出 Limak 使至少 k 名注册用户的贡献值相同所需花费的最少分钟数。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，共有 4 名注册用户，Limak 希望至少有 3 名用户的贡献值相同。Limak 应采取如下行动。
他花费 100 分钟阅读第 4 名用户的一篇博客，并将其贡献值从 1 提高到 6。
然后，他花费 4·30 = 120 分钟阅读第 2 位用户的四条评论，并将其贡献值从 2 提高到 6（每次提高 1，共提高了四次）。
在给定情形下，Limak 花费 100 + 4·30 = 220 分钟，此后用户 2、3、4 的贡献值均为 6。
在第二个样例中，Limak 需要 30 分钟阅读一篇博客，100 分钟阅读一条评论。这一次，他可以花费 100 + 3·30 = 190 分钟，使 3 位用户的贡献值达到 12：
花费 2·30 = 60 分钟阅读第 1 位用户的两篇博客，将其贡献值从 2 提高到 12。
花费 30 + 100 分钟阅读第 3 位用户的一篇博客和一条评论。他的贡献值将从 6 变为 6 + 5 + 1 = 12。
